views.markdown:
Sets a picture or GIF as your Control Center background, one for light mode and one for dark mode.

* pick separate pictures for portrait & landscape.
* play GIFs only while Control Center is open.
* adjust blur & dim with a live preview.
* pause animation in Low Power Mode or when the phone is hot.
* best performance possible in Control Center.

* first release in this repo.
* show the portrait & landscape pictures side by side, tap one to choose or remove it.
* hide Pause Animation to Save Power while Enable Tweak is off.
* add a rootless build.
* add Tip on Ko-fi under Credits.
